_note: F10a: rebuilt so every entry is something the tool is meant to find -- not yet open (permitted / under construction / opening in the next ~18 months, or opened in the last 6 months) or sold in the last 24 months, 20+ units. Buildings that opened longer ago (Northbend, Dwell at 5th and Farmer -- both opened March 2025) were dropped. Every entry is from a source the tool doesn't read (news, press releases, developer sites, the building's own website) -- never a city permit layer or the county sales file. 5 entries carry a hand-verified `software` field read directly off the building's own resident-portal/apply-now links.
